messages:
elaine: Hey team, escalating a customer-reported spike of 503s + streaming timeouts on hosted inference. Customer says this started after they upgraded to SDK v2.4.0 and they see heavy retry loops causing billing spikes. attaching logs below.

bob_acme: We started seeing intermittent 503s around 10:03 UTC, then the SDK retried ~5 times and client gave up. Streaming chunks stop mid-response a few times. Repro steps:
1) init client with api_key XXXXXX (redacted)
2) call streaming chat with max_tokens=2048
3) after ~30-90s, response stalls, then we get "503 Service Unavailable" from /v1/streaming endpoint
4) SDK prints RetryableError and loops with backoff
Logs: 
```
ERROR: request failed: 503
trace_id=rid_0xabc123
sdk_retry=4 backoff=2.3s
stream disconnected, got FIN
```

elaine: Thanks — can you confirm whether you saw any 5xx bodies or only connection resets? Also, do you have correlation trace IDs?

bob_acme: trace_id=rid_0xabc123 is from our side; we forwarded the raw headers. Body was empty in most cases. We also saw a couple 504s when chunking larger responses (>1MB).

sam: I'm on it, looking at gateway metrics now. Quick ask: which region were these hitting?

bob_acme: us-west-2. Their app is behind a single region route.

sam: I see a small spike of 5xx from the streaming gateway at 10:03-10:20 UTC with increased latency and backend worker errors. Root cause not obvious yet. Pulling pod logs and kube events.

raj: From SDK side: v2.4.0 introduced a conservative retry loop that may aggressively retry streaming endpoints — we recently added automatic reconnect for chunked streams. Could lead to duplicate concurrent connections if the library doesn't fully close the socket. Can you paste the client snippet?

bob_acme: ```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-large', messages, onChunk });
```
No custom transport. Default Node runtime.

raj: OK. Two hypotheses: 1) SDK reconnect + gateway transient overload => overload + 503s. 2) Auth token expiry causing premature closes and SDK retrying. Any token refresh logs?

elaine: Customer also mentioned increased billing. They think retries bumped up token counts. We should confirm whether retries are counted against customer usage.

maria: Assigning priority P1 for support-impacting billing + timeouts. Sam, can you confirm if the gateway returned RateLimit or 5xx from backend? Also cc infra oncall.

sam: From metrics, the gateway returned 503 from upstream in ~85% of occurrences; 15% are TLS EOFs. Backend pool available but queue length spiked. No explicit OOMs in pods. I opened a snapshot of the gateway logs and saved traces with trace ids: rid_0xabc123, rid_0xabc124.

triage-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-342. Notifying eng-runtime oncall.

elaine: Next steps:
- sam to attach gateway logs for those trace ids (done)
- raj to audit SDK reconnect behavior and push a hotfix flag to disable double-reconnect
- support to provide customer mitigations (short-term): reduce max_tokens, set max_retries=1, enable streaming heartbeat
- confirm billing treatment for retries

raj: Patch in flight: disable auto-reconnect for streaming by default; will cut a 2.4.1 within the hour and post changelog. Also adding a short circuit if socket already closing.

sam: I grep'd logs for rid_0xabc123: gateway shows "upstream reset" followed by a flurry of new connections from same client IP. Looks like client aggressively reconnects after network hiccup. Gateway connection queue momentarily saturated, returning 503 to new incoming streams. No capacity breach at worker level but spike in concurrent new streams.

elaine: Customer update draft: "We're investigating and believe SDK reconnect behavior + transient network hiccup caused a surge of concurrent stream attempts which briefly overwhelmed the gateway queue. SDK team is releasing a patch to reduce reconnect aggressiveness. As a mitigation, set max_retries=1 and lower streaming window. We'll follow up after a hotfix release." Thoughts?

maria: Good. Add apology and offer to credit excess token usage while we validate billing.

bob_acme: Appreciate quick action. We can temporarily throttle clients and apply retry=1. Please keep us posted with ETA for 2.4.1.

raj: ETA for 2.4.1 is 45 minutes. I'll post the artifact and release notes here when cut.

sam: We'll also add a short-term gateway tweak: increase accept queue and raise per-IP connection soft limit for 30 minutes to absorb retries. Rolling now across us-west-2.

deploy-bot: roll/start gateway-accept-queue-increase us-west-2 by +50% (rollout id=rlt_553)

sam: Patch applied. Monitoring for 10m window. Early signal: 503s drop to baseline, connection resets decreased.

elaine: Sending customer update now. Will follow up after raj posts release. Thanks everyone.

raj: 2.4.1 published: https://npm.redwood.ai/redwood-sdk/v2.4.1 changelog: disable streaming auto-reconnect; opt-in heartbeat. Recommend customers upgrade.

bob_acme: Upgraded and testing. No 503s in the last 20m. Thanks.

elaine: Closing loop: support to issue token credit pending billing check, eng to follow up with postmortem if we see recurrence.

maria: Great cross-team response. Please add a short postmortem note to incidents/ if anything else shows up. :thumbsup:
